Subject: RE: suit with Mckenzie & Associates on behalf of Vincent Hanard

Body.Content: Your suit with Mckenzie & Associates on behalf of Vincent Hanard due to cigarette smoking is ludicrous, in so much as his family said he did not know 'the dangers of smoking'. If Mr. Hanard did not know in the early 60's of this he must have been going around with blinders on. No willpower. I have friends who like to smoke and refuse to give it up. I don't agree with smoking. None of my children smoke. They saw their father die of this but they learned of the dangers in 1964 when he died and took a lesson from it. I'm addicted to cookies. Should I sue Nabisco? I'm glad you did not settle with the Galbraith s of Stanton, CA. Let Belli and his ilk sweat it out. 5C548 8614
